workflowInfo.workflowDescription: Audits every certificate in a RACF keyring and flags certificates expiring within N days

variable.name: KEYRING_OWNER
variable.label: Keyring Owner User ID
variable.abstract: The RACF user ID that owns the keyring
variable.description: The RACF user ID associated with the keyring to audit. For the default z/OSMF keyring this is IZUSVR.

variable.name: KEYRING_NAME
variable.label: Keyring Name
variable.abstract: The name of the RACF keyring to audit
variable.description: The keyring label associated with KEYRING_OWNER. Example: IZUKeyring.IZUDFLT

variable.name: WARN_DAYS
variable.label: Warning Threshold (days)
variable.abstract: Flag any certificate expiring within this many days
variable.description: Any certificate whose expiry date falls within this many days from today will be highlighted with a WARNING flag in the report. Certificates already expired are always flagged EXPIRED. Set to 0 to disable threshold warnings and report expiry dates only.

variable.name: REPORT_DATASET
variable.label: Report Output Dataset
variable.abstract: Optional dataset to capture the report (leave blank for SYSOUT only)
variable.description: If specified, the report output is routed to this pre-allocated sequential dataset (DISP=SHR) in addition to SYSOUT. Leave blank to write to SYSOUT only.

step.name: listKeyring
step.title: List Keyring Contents
step.description: Runs RACDCERT LISTRING to confirm the target keyring exists and display all certificates currently connected to it
step.instructions: This step runs RACDCERT ID(${instance-KEYRING_OWNER}) LISTRING(${instance-KEYRING_NAME}) via IKJEFT01 to confirm the keyring exists and to record the full list of connected certificates before the expiry audit is performed.

step.name: auditExpiry
step.title: Audit Certificate Expiry Dates
step.description: Runs an inline REXX program that uses RACDCERT LISTRING output to enumerate every certificate in the keyring, extracts its expiry date via IRRXUTIL, and flags any certificate expiring within WARN_DAYS days

step.name: captureToDataset
step.title: Copy Report to Dataset (optional)
step.description: Re-runs the audit REXX and routes SYSTSPRT to the named dataset for archival or downstream processing. Only run this step when REPORT_DATASET has been specified.
step.instructions:
Routes the same audit report to dataset ${instance-REPORT_DATASET} for archival or downstream processing.
Pre-requisites: - The dataset must already exist and be catalogued. - DISP=SHR is used; ensure no other job has it open exclusively. - Only execute this step when REPORT_DATASET has been filled in.
